title: fix(fields): a tap on a lookup picker option's preview chip selects the option
body:
Fixes #36479
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmNmMEXS4EzeVz9RjvD

## 维护者速读

- 用户在关联字段的下拉选择里点选项下方预览中的记录标签（如「客户：Fabrikam」），以前会直接跳到那条记录、编辑被丢下；现在点选项任何位置都是选中该选项，手机和电脑一样。
- 记录页字段区的体验修补，替在手机上编辑关联字段的用户解决「点错就跳走」的问题。
- 出错时最坏是预览里的记录标签或邮箱、网址不再能点开（本来在选择框里也不该点开）；记录页、列表里的链接不受影响，改动可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

The lookup quick-picker's option preview drew each extra column through the read cell. A reference column became a link to its record whenever the host answers `recordHref` (on a record page, the record chip), and that link's click handler stops propagation and calls the host's `openRecord`, so the option row's own click never fired. An `email` / `url` / `phone` / file column did the same with its own anchor (the email cell's anchor also stops propagation).

`renderLookupColumnValue` is the one renderer both picker surfaces call (the dropdown preview and the browse-all dialog table). It now carries the picker rule the dialog applied on its own (objectui#11903, point 7): every candidate cell renders under a host with no record destination (`WithoutRecordLinks`), so a reference keeps its face (the chip included) without the anchor or hover card, and a self-linking type is drawn with the `text` face. The fix sits where the preview gets the read cell's link; no event is swallowed anywhere.

Desktop answer the card asked for: yes, the same click navigated with a mouse too. The defect was the link's click handler, not the pointer type; the pin drives both `[TouchA]` and `[MouseLeft]`.

## First read (by risk)

1. `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/lookupColumnDisplay.tsx`: the renderer branch of `renderLookupColumnValue` (face substitution + `WithoutRecordLinks`).
2. `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.previewLinkFree-36479.test.tsx`: the pin.

## Acceptance notes

- `RecordPickerDialog.tsx` keeps its own `SELF_LINKING_CELL_TYPES` substitution and `WithoutRecordLinks` wrapper; with the rule now in the shared renderer they are redundant there (idempotent, no behaviour change). Removing them is outside this card's file surface and left in place.
- The record page's chip face (`ReferenceChipContext`) still reaches the preview through the popover, so a reference in an option preview draws as an unlinked chip there and as plain text elsewhere. Unchanged here; noted only.
